memoryRule: the first seam stays geometrically neutral; a non-adjacent second seam creates a pressure span that peels one lamina, seals another, and sheds a third; four spans remain liftable
interactionRule: click or focus two non-adjacent seam nodes; the first selection stays still and the second commits; Enter, Space, and the pinch control use a deterministic pair; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: Canvas 2D crease sheet, WebGL eclipse slab, and directional membrane -> nine browser-native DOM/CSS laminae with independent clip paths
compositionRupture: single sheet, shallow object, and monolithic skin -> overlapping diagonal stack around an open interior
encounterRupture: draw a stroke, trace a route, or reverse a direction -> choose two material boundaries and create an interval between them
temporalRupture: drying frontier, remote eclipse ledger, and directional tension -> layer-order memory where peel, seal, and shed roles compound
mediumRupture: p5.js Canvas 2D and WebGL -> semantic DOM nodes and CSS clip-path/transform geometry with no canvas or SVG renderer
changedRule: Pressure is an interval between two non-adjacent seams. The first boundary is neutral; the second commits a structural peel, seal, and shed across the layered surface.
visibleConsequence: A blind stack of nine independent skins becomes visibly re-layered after a valid pair: one skin lifts and opens, one closes, and a third sheds its underside; four changes persist in later spans.
falsifier: Delete if one seam commits, if the pair becomes a copied line, if peel/seal/shed are only colour or readout, if the stack reads as a control grid, if later spans reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v038 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the lamina stack from the preceding crease sheet, slab, or membrane grammar, or if the pressure interval is not materially visible.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
